raw_response:
This is my small bean plot, just a tiny piece — only about one-sixteenth of a hectare — and I am growing beans mixed with other crops. Beans here in Iringa do well enough on their own without chemical fertilizer, and anyway the cost is too high for such a small plot, especially for legumes. I will put a little manure from the household if I have some, use the seed I saved from last harvest like most of us do, and weed it myself with the hoe. The plot is too small to bother hiring anyone.
